steps.name: Extend PipelineTrack with showcase and onStageClick props
steps.description: Add optional `showcase` boolean prop and `onStageClick` callback prop to PipelineTrack. When showcase=true: all stages render as reached (colored, no gray future segments), each stage marker becomes an anchor link (<a href="#statusSlug">) instead of a passive span, and the click handler is wired to onStageClick. No real idea data is required in showcase mode. When showcase is false or absent, PipelineTrack renders identically to current behavior. The stage slug for the anchor href is the lowercase status string (e.g., '#submitted', '#in_voting').
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: PipelineTrack accepts optional showcase?: boolean and onStageClick?: (status: Status) => void props
AC-2: When showcase=true, all stages render as reached (colored track segments, filled markers, no gray future segments)
AC-3: When showcase=true, each marker renders as <a href="#statusSlug"> (e.g., #submitted) instead of a span
AC-4: Clicking a showcase marker calls onStageClick with the clicked stage's Status value
AC-5: When showcase=false or absent, PipelineTrack renders identically to current behavior (no visual or DOM change)
AC-6: Existing PipelineTrack tests continue to pass without modification
AC-7: TypeScript compiles
steps.scenario_name: PipelineTrack showcase mode renders all stages as clickable anchors
deliverables: New test cases for showcase mode
quality_gates: Non-showcase PipelineTrack renders unchanged (existing tests pass)
Showcase mode renders all stages as reached
Showcase markers are anchor elements with correct href values
onStageClick fires with correct Status on click
No console errors in either mode
TypeScript compiles

phases.name: Page and Integration
phases.description: HowItWorksContent client component, page route, navigation entry points, CSS :target wiring

steps.name: Create HowItWorksContent client component
steps.description: Create the main client component at src/components/ideas/how-it-works-content.tsx. It owns activeStage state and IntersectionObserver for scroll-spy. Renders: (1) Sticky pipeline hero using PipelineTrack with showcase=true and onStageClick that scrolls to the corresponding card. Pipeline sticks below nav (sticky top-16). Pipeline unsticks after the last stage card via a sentinel element that triggers unstick. (2) 6 StageCards, each with an id matching the status slug (e.g., id='submitted'), a Badge showing the status label, a description from HowItWorks namespace, and a nextStep line. (3) Terminal section heading ('What if things don't go as planned?') with 4 TerminalCards showing a colored dot (matching ExceptionState markerColor convention) and terminal description. (4) CTA section with a link to browse ideas. IntersectionObserver watches each StageCard's intersection and updates activeStage; the active stage marker in the pipeline gets a visual highlight.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: HowItWorksContent renders PipelineTrack in showcase mode with all 6 forward stages shown as reached
AC-2: Pipeline sticks below nav on scroll (sticky top-16) and unsticks after the last stage card
AC-3: IntersectionObserver tracks which stage card is in viewport and updates activeStage state
AC-4: Clicking a pipeline marker scrolls to the corresponding stage card (via hash URL anchor)
AC-5: 6 StageCards render with id attribute matching status slug, Badge, description, and nextStep
AC-6: Terminal section renders 4 TerminalCards with colored dots and terminal descriptions
AC-7: CTA section renders with a link to the ideas page
AC-8: All visible strings come from the HowItWorks i18n namespace
AC-9: Component is a client component ('use client')
AC-10: No real idea data is required (showcase mode uses static stage data)
steps.scenario_name: HowItWorksContent renders sticky pipeline, stage cards, terminal section, and CTA
deliverables: Component tests for layout, scroll-spy, and click-to-scroll
quality_gates: PipelineTrack renders in showcase mode without errors
Sticky behavior works (sticks on scroll, unsticks after last card)
IntersectionObserver updates activeStage without errors
Click-to-scroll navigates to correct card
All 6 StageCards and 4 TerminalCards render
No hardcoded strings
